consequence.statement: Controller pods get an additional app.kubernetes.io/part-of: flux label; the evidence states no operational failure.

original.statement: Flux controller pod manifests now carry the label app.kubernetes.io/part-of: flux.

decision.reason: [ev-cd6e13ea0600] only says that the `app.kubernetes.io/part-of: flux` label is added to controller pods. It describes this as a manifest feature and does not mention any failure, rejection, ignored setting, lost access or required migration. That rules out every failure kind. The text also does not describe any changed default or difference in runtime behaviour, so behavior-change isn't supported either. The proposed kind "none" (informational, low severity), with a statement that only describes the extra label, matches the evidence.
